title: Essential Verb - {vouloir} (to want)
description: Express what you want! Master desires through active recall and composition practice!
can_do: Express what you want (I want, you want, they want)
Make polite requests and express desires
Say 'I want this book' or 'Do you want that?' in French

concepts.definition: Essential irregular verb for expressing desires and polite requests! One of the most common verbs in French.
concepts.example: 'I want that' ({Je veux ça}), 'Do you want a book?' ({Veux-tu un livre?}), 'We want to have a house' ({Nous voulons avoir une maison})

concepts.definition: Notice the pattern: je/tu both use '{veux}', then il/elle use '{veut}', nous uses '{voulons}', and ils/elles use '{veulent}'!
concepts.example: {je veux}, {tu veux}, {il veut}, {nous voulons}, {vous voulez}, {ils veulent}

concepts.definition: Combine vouloir with previous modules for infinite expressions. Use with ça, être, avoir, and nouns you've learned!
concepts.example: {je veux + ça, nous voulons + être, ils veulent + avoir + un livre}

mistakes.feedback: Je takes '{veux}', not 'veut'. Remember: je veux, il veut
That's 'you want', not 'I want'. Focus on the pronoun!
Tu takes '{veux}', not 'veut'. Pattern: je veux, tu veux
Il takes '{veut}', not 'veux'. Remember: il veut, elle veut
Elle takes '{veut}', not 'veux'. Same as il veut

items.hint: Conjugate '{vouloir}' in the present for '{nous}' (regular -ons ending).

mistakes.feedback: Nous takes '{voulons}', not 'veux'. Completely different!
Nous takes '{voulons}', not 'veut'. Regular -ons pattern!

items.hint: Conjugate '{vouloir}' in the present for '{vous}' (regular -ez ending).

mistakes.feedback: Vous takes '{voulez}', not 'veux'. Regular -ez pattern!
Vous takes '{voulez}', not 'veut'. Remember: vous voulez
Ils takes '{veulent}', not 'veux'. Irregular ending!
Ils takes '{veulent}', not 'veut'. Plural form!
Elles takes '{veulent}', not 'veux'. Same as ils veulent
Elles takes '{veulent}', not 'veut'. Plural form!

items.situation: Say what you want to be
items.cue: I want to be a friend
items.hint: Use '{vouloir}' in the present for '{je}' + infinitive '{être}' + 'a friend'.

mistakes.feedback: This needs vouloir! Try: je veux être un ami
When you use two verbs together, the second one stays in the infinitive. Here: je veux être un ami.

items.situation: Say what you want to have
items.cue: I want to have a cat
items.hint: Use '{vouloir}' in the present for '{je}' + infinitive '{avoir}' + 'a cat'.

mistakes.feedback: This needs vouloir! Try: je veux avoir un chat
When you chain two verbs, the second verb should be in the infinitive. Here: je veux avoir un chat.

items.situation: Say what she wants to have
items.cue: She wants to have a house
items.hint: Use '{vouloir}' in the present for '{elle}' + infinitive '{avoir}' + 'a house'.

mistakes.feedback: This needs vouloir! Try: elle veut avoir une maison
Elle takes '{veut}', not 'veux'. Remember: elle veut, il veut.
